Starting today, Saved Views is available to every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you no longer have to rebuild the same list configuration every time you open a project. Set up a view once—by status, assignee, priority, due date, or any combination that matches how your team works—and it stays ready whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize views around different projects, clients, or workflows. Views aren't limited to your own workspace, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone looks at the same filtered list instead of recreating it from scratch or sending screenshots back and forth. This makes onboarding new teammates faster and keeps reporting consistent across the board.

Saved Views is live now and included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
